about: Net margin per hectare of rainfed (secano) crops in Andalucía, copied from MAPA ECREA 2.0 'Resultados técnico-económicos' (source: Red Contable Agraria Nacional, RECAN). Only values read as text from the PDFs are listed; tables printed as images were not read.
metric: ECREA '16. Margen neto (15-8)', euro/ha: production value + coupled subsidies + other income, minus direct costs, machinery, hired labour, paid indirect costs and depreciation. Decoupled payments and opportunity costs (family labour, own land, own capital) are not included.
currency: EUR, current prices of each year (not inflation-adjusted)

missing_value.source: TBD: a crop without a verified net margin counts as 0 euro/ha (no sale, costs not counted) until a value is found

score_scale.source: TBD: linear, 0 euro/ha or less = 0, highest net margin in this file (chickpea group, 2020) = 100; team to confirm

Sunflower.note: The 2018 and 2019 Andalucía tables are images in the PDFs and were not read.

Chickpea.note: ECREA reports lentils, chickpeas and vetches as one group; the group value is used for chickpea. One year only.

Lentil.note: ECREA reports lentils, chickpeas and vetches as one group; the group value is used for lentil (same value as chickpea). One year only.

Vetch (forage / green manure).note: TBD: the ECREA legume group covers vetch sold as grain, not vetch used as forage or green manure.

Winter cover crop.note: TBD: a cover crop is not sold; its costs are not in ECREA.

Fallow.note: No crop is sold in a fallow year: counted as 0 euro/ha, like the other crops without a verified value. TBD: tillage costs of the fallow year are not counted.
